verdict.rationale: Consensus describes itself as having evolved from a search tool into a research agent. That agent chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery on top of its search engine. A separate Deep Search mode produces more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies. Together these clearly position it beyond single-pass summaries. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the agent plans and iterates its investigation steps, independent or hands-on corroboration that the multi-step process works as claimed.
